faq.question: Is Shopify meant to replace Amazon for your clients?
faq.answer: No. We position Shopify as a complementary owned channel that supports brand presence, bundles, and retention around Amazon growth.

faq.question: Do you rebuild existing Shopify stores?
faq.answer: Yes. We can refine or rebuild existing storefronts when conversion, speed, or maintainability is limiting growth.

faq.question: Can product content match Amazon listings?
faq.answer: Yes. We align owned-site messaging with proven Amazon product points while adapting format for a brand website.

faq.question: Which Shopify plan do I need?
faq.answer: Plan choice depends on traffic, checkout needs, and integrations. We recommend a practical setup during scoping rather than prescribing a plan before review.

faq.question: Do you handle ongoing site updates?
faq.answer: Launch builds can include a handoff for your team, or ongoing update support depending on the engagement scope.

faq.question: How does this connect to email marketing?
faq.answer: We set up capture and tracking foundations so lifecycle email can support customers acquired from both Amazon and DTC.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do your brand clients sell in?
faq.answer: Our Amazon growth work supports official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Shopify storefront scope is confirmed separately during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a channel audit, information architecture, build, then launch QA.
